comment: The demo library for the documentation screenshots. Every asset is openly licensed or public domain; tests/demo_library/assets.json records where each came from. Times are PINNED (now = 1790000000) so every run of the mock answers byte-identically.

movies.title: Spring
movies.summary: A shepherd girl and her dog climb into the mountains to face the ancient spirits who hold back the thaw, and to keep the cycle of life turning. A wordless fable of fear, loss and renewal, painted in moss, snow and firelight.

movies.title: Sintel
movies.summary: A lone young woman crosses frozen wastes and ruined cities in search of Scales, the baby dragon she rescued and raised before it was taken from her. The closer she comes to the dragons' lair, the less certain she is of what she will find there.

movies.title: Sprite Fright
movies.summary: A group of rowdy teenagers on a weekend in the woods discovers that the forest's tiny, adorable mushroom sprites do not take kindly to litter. An eighties-style creature comedy in which the cute things are the monsters.

movies.title: Charge
movies.summary: In a frozen, energy-starved future, an old man breaks into a guarded facility to steal a single battery, and meets the machine built to stop him.

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.summary: In a future Amsterdam overrun by machines, a band of scientists and soldiers gathers in the Oude Kerk to restage one heartbreaking moment from the past, in the hope that changing it will stop the robots before they ever rise.

movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep called Franck meets Victor, a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime: a chance to live a different life, and then another.

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.summary: A gentle giant of a rabbit wakes up to a perfect spring morning, until three bullying rodents flatten his favourite butterfly. Revenge, it turns out, is best served with elaborate traps.

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.summary: Old Proog leads young Emo through the Machine, an endless world of wires, pistons and impossible rooms that Proog insists is full of wonders. Emo is beginning to see it differently.

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.summary: A young estate agent travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the reclusive Count Orlok, and brings the plague home with him. Murnau's shadow-haunted symphony of horror is the vampire film every other one remembers.

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.summary: In a gleaming city of towers, the son of its master descends to the machine halls below and falls for Maria, who preaches peace to the workers, while his father and an inventor plot to replace her with a machine in her likeness.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.summary: Seven strangers barricade themselves in a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in, and discover that the arguments inside may kill them before the things outside do.

movies.title: The General
movies.summary: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, with his sweetheart aboard, a Southern railroad engineer gives chase alone, in one of the great sustained action sequences in film history.

movies.title: Sherlock Jr.
movies.summary: A projectionist who studies to be a detective is framed for a theft, falls asleep in the booth, and walks straight into the film on screen to solve the case.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.summary: A newspaper editor learns that his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, is about to remarry and quit, and lures her back for one last story: a condemned man, a corrupt city hall, and a deadline.

movies.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
movies.summary: Aliens alarmed by humanity's weapons put their ninth plan into action: raise the dead of a small California cemetery. An airline pilot and his wife stand in their way.

movies.title: The Kid
movies.summary: The Tramp finds an abandoned baby in an alley and, against his better judgement, raises him. Five years later, the authorities come for the boy.

movies.title: Safety Last!
movies.summary: A department-store clerk who has told his girl back home that he runs the place stages a publicity stunt to win a thousand dollars, and ends up climbing the building himself.

movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.summary: A fairground showman arrives in a small town with a sleepwalker who, he claims, can see the future. That night the murders begin.

movies.title: A Trip to the Moon
movies.summary: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the Moon from a giant cannon, lands in the eye of the Man in the Moon, and meets the Selenites.

movies.title: Wing It!
movies.summary: An uptight engineer gets an unwelcome visit from an enthusiastic wannabe-pilot, causing both of them to be launched into the air inside an out-of-control space shuttle.

movies.title: Coffee Run
movies.summary: Fueled by caffeine, a young woman runs through the bittersweet memories of her past relationship.

movies.title: Hero
movies.summary: A showcase for Grease Pencil in Blender 2.8: 2D animation tools within a full 3D pipeline, and the sixth short film funded by the Blender Cloud.

movies.title: Glass Half
movies.summary: Two amateur art critics meet in a gallery and argue passionately about the pieces they see, causing chaos for everyone else, until finally they find a piece on which they can agree.

movies.title: The Daily Dweebs
movies.summary: A Blender Animation Studio short, directed and animated by Hjalti Hjalmarsson.

movies.title: Singularity
movies.summary: When an ominous cosmic event swallows the icy home of a small space critter, he must find refuge among a group of luminous creatures watched over by a mysterious celestial being.

movies.title: Sita Sings the Blues
movies.summary: The Ramayana, told with the torch songs of Annette Hanshaw: Sita, loyal to a husband who doubts her, and an animator in New York whose own marriage is coming apart.

movies.title: Seder-Masochism
movies.summary: An animated musical that loosely follows the Passover Seder story, with the events of Exodus retold by Moses, Aharon, the Angel of Death, Jesus and the director's father, and a goddess's point of view restored.

shows.title: Caminandes
shows.summary: Koro the llama lives in Patagonia and has one talent: finding obstacles between himself and whatever he wants next. Short slapstick episodes about fences, friendship and snacks.

episodes.title: Llama Drama
episodes.summary: Koro meets a fence between himself and the other side of the road, and refuses to go around it.

episodes.title: Gran Dillama
episodes.summary: The grass is greener beyond an electric fence. Koro takes that personally.

episodes.title: Llamigos
episodes.summary: Winter in Patagonia, one last berry bush, and a penguin called Oti who wants the berries too.

shows.title: Sherlock Holmes
shows.summary: A young, dry-witted Sherlock Holmes and a steady Dr. Watson take the cases that walk in off Baker Street, in thirty-nine half-hour mysteries shot in France for American television.

episodes.title: The Case of the Cunningham Heritage
episodes.summary: Holmes and Watson investigate the suspicious death of a wealthy patriarch, entangled with a disputed inheritance and a household full of people who each stood to gain from his death.

episodes.title: The Case of the Pennsylvania Gun
episodes.summary: A rare antique firearm becomes the center of a theft and murder investigation that Holmes must untangle from a web of collectors and forgers.

episodes.title: The Case of Lady Beryl
episodes.summary: A noblewoman seeks Holmes's help after a string of threats against her household, which turns out to connect to an old secret she's been keeping.

episodes.title: The Belligerent Ghost
episodes.summary: A supposedly haunted house is terrorising its new tenants, and Holmes sets out to prove -- as usual -- that the 'ghost' has a very physical explanation.

episodes.title: The Case of the Shy Ballerina
episodes.summary: A prima ballerina's stage fright turns out to be tangled up with a threat against her life, and Holmes has to work out who in the company wants her gone.

shows.title: Hubblecast
shows.note: Episodes 84-133 (2015-2020), numbered as ESA/Hubble numbers them. Left out: 100, 105 and 129, whose preview frames show an ESA/Hubble wordmark or logo, which the CC BY licence does not cover (https://esahubble.org/copyright/); 90, whose presenter wears one; and 85, 89, 94, 95, 101, 104, 113 and 116, whose frames show a private person or third-party material. Titles, dates and runtimes are from each episode's esahubble.org page; summaries open its text.
shows.summary: ESA/Hubble's video podcast about the discoveries of the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope, and about the telescope itself. The episodes here are those of 2015 to 2020.

episodes.title: A starry snapshot for Hubble’s 25th
episodes.summary: This Hubblecast explores the new image of star cluster Westerlund 2, taken by the NASA/ESA Hubble Space telescope and released to celebrate its 25th year in orbit. Credit:

episodes.title: The wings of the Twin Jet Nebula
episodes.summary: This Hubblecast explores the wings of Twin Jet Nebula which were observed and studied by the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope. Credit:

episodes.title: The many mysteries of Pluto
episodes.summary: Before NASA's New Horizons probe flew past Pluto in July 2015, almost all of the information scientists had about this mysterious dwarf planet came from observations made by Hubble.

episodes.title: Mysterious Ripples Found Racing Through Planet-forming Disc
episodes.summary: Using images from the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope and ESO’s Very Large Telescope, astronomers have discovered unique and totally unexpected structures within the dusty disc around the star AU Microscopii. Credit:

episodes.title: The future of Hubble, part 1
episodes.summary: In April 2016 the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope celebrates its 26th year in orbit. During this time the telescope has made many remarkable discoveries. But what comes next?

episodes.title: 26th anniversary
episodes.summary: On 24 April 1990, the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope was sent into orbit aboard the space shuttle Discovery. Now it is celebrating its 26th anniversary. As in the last years Hubble spent a modest portion of its observing time to observe a special chosen object.

episodes.title: Telescope Teamwork
episodes.summary: The NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope is one of the most sophisticated telescopes in the world. But even Hubble cannot uncover all secrets of the Universe on its own.

episodes.title: How many galaxies are there?
episodes.summary: Since Edwin Hubble discovered that the Milky Way is not the only galaxy in the Universe astronomers try to find out how many of them are there. This new Hubblecast focusses on the question “How many galaxies are there?” including the new numbers achieved in 2016. Credit:

episodes.title: Hubble, exoplanets and the hunt for life
episodes.summary: Since astronomers discovered that the stars in the sky are other suns, humanity has wondered if they are also orbited by planets and if those planets host alien life.

episodes.title: Hubble’s biggest discoveries — part 1
episodes.summary: Since its launch in 1990, Hubble has revolutionised our knowledge of astronomy. From imaging the most stunning phenomena in the cosmos, to the study of the invisible parts of the Universe, to observing the most distant objects ever seen.

episodes.title: Hubble’s biggest discoveries — part 2
episodes.summary: To many, Hubble is best known for its stunning images of celestial objects, but among astronomers it is admired for the valuable data it delivers.

episodes.title: Taking the fingerprints of exoplanets
episodes.summary: The atmosphere of an exoplanet can reveal a wealth of information, such as the planet’s temperature, its air pressure, and whether it is suitable for life.

episodes.title: Hubble observes source of gravitational waves for the first time
episodes.summary: Astronomers using the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope have observed a visible counterpart to gravitational waves for the first time: a kilonova from merging neutron stars. For the first time, Hubble has observed the source of a gravitational wave: the merging of two neutron stars.

episodes.title: Light: Flying through the Orion Nebula
episodes.summary: This visualisation takes the viewer on a breathtaking flight through the Orion Nebula, a nearby star-forming region. The video has been produced using scientific imagery and data from the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope.

episodes.title: Decoding the colours of NGC 3344
episodes.summary: Our eyes detect only visible light, but on board Hubble are a variety of instruments that together detect many different wavelengths of light.

episodes.title: Light: Hubble finds most distant star
episodes.summary: Astronomers have used Hubble to make an incredible discovery — they have observed the most distant star ever seen. The bright blue star existed only 4.4 billion years after the Big Bang.

episodes.title: Diving into the Lagoon Nebula
episodes.summary: On 24 April 1990, Hubble was launched into space. To celebrate its 28th year in orbit, some of Hubble’s precious observation time was used to observe the colourful Lagoon Nebula.

episodes.title: Light: New test of Einstein’s general relativity
episodes.summary: An international team of astronomers using Hubble has made the most precise test of general relativity yet outside our Milky Way. A nearby galaxy acts as a strong gravitational lens, distorting light from a distant galaxy behind it to create an Einstein ring around its centre.

episodes.title: Hubble sees `Oumuamua getting a boost
episodes.summary: Astronomers have found that ‘Oumuamua, the first interstellar object discovered in the Solar System, is moving away from the Sun faster than expected.

episodes.title: Light: Mars and Saturn
episodes.summary: Mars and Saturn are among the most popular planets. This new episode of the Hubblecast presents the images Hubble took of these planets in summer 2018. You can subscribe to the Hubblecasts in iTunes , receive future episodes on YouTube or follow us on Vimeo .

episodes.title: How does Hubble orientate itself in space?
episodes.summary: This new Hubblecast episode takes a detailed look into the refined Pointing Control System that allows Hubble to keep its gaze into the Universe firm and steady. Credit:

episodes.title: Light: Triangulum Galaxy in unrivalled detail
episodes.summary: The NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope has captured the most detailed image yet of a the Triangulum Galaxy, a spiral galaxy located at a distance of only three million light-years. The image of our cosmic neighbour is the second largest image ever created with Hubble data.

episodes.title: Light: Hubble & Gaia weigh the Milky Way
episodes.summary: Measurements from the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope and the ESA Gaia mission have been combined to improve he estimate of the mass of our home galaxy the Milky Way: 1.5 trillion solar masses.

episodes.title: How the first stars transformed the Universe
episodes.summary: Right after the Universe started with the Big Bang, the cosmos was dark. Only the first stars created millions of years later brought light. These first stars and their radiation drastically changed the Universe during what is known as the epoch of reionisation.

episodes.title: Hubble’s 29th anniversary
episodes.summary: On 18 April 2019 Hubble is celebrating its 29th year in space. For this anniversary NASA and ESA dedicated a small amount of its precious observation time to take a look at the beautiful Southern Crab Nebula.

episodes.title: Light: Continued Discrepancy in the Universe's Expansion Rate
episodes.summary: Measurements of today's expansion rate do not match the rate that was expected based on how the Universe appeared shortly after the Big Bang over 13 billion years ago.

episodes.title: What can we learn from exoplanet transits?
episodes.summary: This new Hubblecast episode explores what we can learn through the transits of exoplanets. It also tells us what we have learned from these transits with the help of Hubble and which discoveries we can expect with the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope. Credit:

episodes.title: Light: The Evolution of Eta Carinae
episodes.summary: This Hubblecast explores the various observations the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope has made of the Eta Carinae in various wavelengths. Credit:

episodes.title: Light: Jupiter’s Great Red Spot
episodes.summary: This video highlights Jupiter’s trademark spot and observations made of the feature by the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope that demonstrate that the spot has shrunk over time. Credit:

episodes.title: Light: Exoplanet K2-18b
episodes.summary: This Hubblecast Light highlights the exciting discovery of the first water detected on a potentially habitable planet.

episodes.title: Light: Hubble Studies High-Energy Gamma Ray Burst
episodes.summary: New observations from the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope have investigated the nature of the powerful gamma-ray burst GRB 190114C by studying its environment.

episodes.title: From Ultraviolet to Infrared: Comparing the Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes
episodes.summary: This Hubblecast explores how the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope’s observations differ across different wavelengths of the electromagnetic spectrum, and how these observations will be complemented by those of the upcoming NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope . Credit:

episodes.title: Light: The Mysteries of Fomalhaut b
episodes.summary: Data from the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope have revealed an expanding cloud of dust that was likely produced in a collision between two large bodies orbiting the bright nearby star Fomalhaut. Credit:

episodes.title: 30 Years of Science with the Hubble Space Telescope
episodes.summary: On 24 April 1990 the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope was sent into orbit aboard the space shuttle Discovery, the first space telescope of its kind.

episodes.title: Light: Hubble Studies the Earth during a Total Lunar Eclipse
episodes.summary: Taking advantage of a total lunar eclipse in January 2019, astronomers using the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope have measured the amount of ozone in Earth’s atmosphere.

episodes.title: Special: Showcase of Hubble's 30th Anniversary Artistic Creations
episodes.summary: On 24 April 2020, the NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope celebrated its 30th anniversary. ESA/Hubble invited the general public to submit Hubble-themed artistic creations to celebrate this special milestone.

episodes.title: Light: The Strange Exoplanet That Resembles the Long-Sought “Planet Nine”
episodes.summary: The NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope has discovered an 11-Jupiter-mass exoplanet called HD106906 b that occupies an unlikely orbit around a double star 336 light-years away.

episodes.title: Spectroscopy with Hubble
episodes.summary: How does spectroscopy work and what can the study of light tell us about the Universe? How are astronomers using spectroscopy to study exoplanets in the search for life?
